settings.tagline: From sizzling Jollof and Basmati specials to Pizza, Shawarma, Burgers and more — your favourite meals are now just a tap away.

items.name: Sizzling Smoky Jollof Rice
items.description: Firewood-smoked party jollof cooked with plum tomatoes, sweet bell peppers, and fragrant bay leaf spices.

items.name: Chef's Special Basmati Fried Rice
items.description: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice tossed with sweet corn, crunchy carrots, green peas, and diced liver.

items.name: Cozy Native Ofada Rice Special
items.description: Traditional aromatic unpolished rice accompanied by rich spicy Ayamase stew, diced assorted meats and boiled egg.

items.name: Double Cozy Beef Burger
items.description: Two seasoned grilled beef patties, melted cheddar, sweet caramelized onions, lettuce, and secret cozy house sauce.

items.name: Crispy Golden Chicken Burger
items.description: Crunchy buttermilk-marinated fried chicken thigh, spicy coleslaw, garlic aioli, and brioche bun.

items.name: Jumbo Chicken Shawarma (Double Sausage)
items.description: Spiced shredded chicken, dual beef frankfurters, crisp cabbage, creamy garlic drizzle wrapped in toasted pita.

items.name: Cozy Pepperoni Feast Pizza (Medium)
items.description: Handcrafted stone-baked crust, rich herb marinara, loaded with savory sliced pepperoni and bubbling mozzarella.

items.name: BBQ Chicken & Sweetcorn Pizza (Medium)
items.description: Tender barbecue chicken morsels, sweet golden corn, red bell peppers, and stretchy premium mozzarella.

items.name: Pounded Yam & Rich Egusi Soup
items.description: Steaming smooth pounded yam served with thick ground melon seed egusi, bitterleaf, and dry fish stock.

items.name: Yellow Eba & Seafood Okro Soup
items.description: Soft bendable yellow garri eba served with fresh diced crunchy okro, fresh tiger prawns, and smoked fish broth.

items.name: Sizzling Catfish Pepper Soup (Point & Kill)
items.description: Fresh tender catfish cutlets slow-cooked in aromatic native Uda, Uziza, scent leaves, and spicy broth.

items.name: Spicy Goat Meat Pepper Soup
items.description: Succulent bite-sized goat meat simmered in deeply spiced habanero and traditional botanical broth.

items.name: Fried Crispy Chicken (Quarter)
items.description: Well seasoned crispy golden fried chicken with savory seasoning. Perfect as an add-on or on its own.

items.name: Tender Stewed Beef (2 pcs)
items.description: Slow-cooked prime beef chunks drenched in rich pepper sauce.

items.name: Jumbo Fried Croaker Fish
items.description: Crispy whole croaker fish cutlet seasoned with red pepper marinade.

items.name: Golden Fried Plantain (Dodo)
items.description: Sweet, caramelised ripe plantain slices fried to golden perfection.

items.name: Crispy French Fries
items.description: Hot and crispy salted potato fries with dip.

items.name: Cozy Golden Meat Pie
items.description: Flaky buttery crust filled with seasoned minced beef, potatoes, and carrots.

items.name: Signature Cozy Chapman
items.description: Classic Nigerian sparkling Chapman infused with citrus, cucumber slices, and Angostura aromatics.

items.name: Fresh Chilled Pineapple Zobo
items.description: Natural chilled hibiscus drink infused with fresh pressed pineapple and spicy ginger extract.
